explanation: The link says it reads the policy raw shape at AdmxStructures.vb:41, which is AdmxPolicy.ID. Lines 7-18 of DetailPolicy.vb never read ID: they read AdmxFile.SourceFile (via DefinedIn, line 7) and DisplayCode, ExplainCode, PresentationID and Section of AdmxPolicy. Retarget it at the declaration of the AdmxPolicy class (AdmxStructures.vb:40) or the field it actually reads, and add the matching reads for the AdmxFile shape through DefinedIn if you keep per-shape links.
